name: chartquery-mcp
description: ChartQuery chart and QR code API for Claude.
long_description: Generate chart images, diagrams, barcodes, QR codes and thermal labels on demand. PNG, SVG or PDF output.

tools.name: barcode
tools.description: Generate a barcode image via GET. Output: SVG (default) or PNG. Supports 25+ formats: EAN-13, Code 128, ITF-14, GS1-128, postal codes and more.

tools.name: chart
tools.description: Render a Chart.js image via GET. Pass the full chart object as URL-encoded JSON in query. Prefer format png for ChatGPT. POST sends the same object as a JSON body, not query.

tools.name: chart_ai
tools.description: Describe a chart in plain English via GET and get a rendered image back. Powered by AI.

tools.name: chart_render
tools.description: Render a previously saved chart by ID. Public, no API key required. Supports URL overrides for templates (?data1=, ?labels=, ?title=…).

tools.name: chart_view
tools.description: View a previously saved chart as an interactive HTML page. Public, no API key required. Iframe-embeddable.

tools.name: diagram
tools.description: Render a diagram via GET. Use type (mermaid, d2, …), query (source code), and format=png for ChatGPT. POST uses diagram_type and diagram_source instead.

tools.name: diagram_ai
tools.description: Describe a diagram in plain English via GET and get a rendered image back. Powered by AI.

tools.name: diagram_render
tools.description: Render a previously saved diagram by ID. Public, no API key required. Supports ?format= and ?query= overrides.

tools.name: diagram_view
tools.description: View a previously saved diagram as an HTML page. Public, no API key required. Iframe-embeddable with inline SVG rendering.

tools.name: label
tools.description: Preview a thermal label via GET. Pass the same label object as a URL-encoded JSON string in query. Inside that JSON, text items use content and size (1-10), not text or fontSize. Prefer format=png fo…

tools.name: label_compile
tools.description: Compile a label to printer commands (tsc, zpl, epl, …). POST width, language, and elements. Text uses content and size (1-10), not text or fontSize. No barcode element. Example: {"width":40,"height":…

tools.name: label_convert
tools.description: Convert printer commands from one language to another. POST source, from, and to. from is the source language (tsc, zpl, epl, …). to is the target (tsc, zpl, escpos, …).

tools.name: label_parse
tools.description: Parse printer commands into structured elements. POST source and language (tsc, zpl, epl, …).

tools.name: label_render
tools.description: Render a previously saved label by ID. Public, no API key required. Supports ?format= override.

tools.name: label_validate
tools.description: Validate printer commands. POST source (the raw commands) and language (tsc, zpl, epl, …).

tools.name: label_view
tools.description: View a previously saved label as an HTML page. Public, no API key required. Iframe-embeddable with inline SVG rendering.

tools.name: qrcode
tools.description: Generate a styled QR code via GET. Output: SVG (default) or PNG. Supports dot styles, gradients, custom corners and all QR versions.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Infrastructure health for an engine or endpoint over the last hour. Not scoped to your account or tenant. Enabled per account: HTTP 403 means contact support to activate it.

tools.name: usage
tools.description: Return this account's Chartquery usage and credit balance. No body. Requires an API key.
